title: Thai-Style Pork Roast with Slovakian Twist
description: A unique fusion of Thai flavors and Slovakian ingredients, this pork roast is a must-try.

ingredients.name: slovakian
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup pickled red cabbage, finely chopped

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together fish sauce, pickled red cabbage, brown sugar, soy sauce, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the pork roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork roast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
While the pork is resting, mix together the minced garlic and grated ginger in a small bowl.
Serve the sliced pork with the garlic-ginger mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional pickled red cabbage, if desired.
